title: Hot dogs eaten in a fluoroscopy stomach-capacity test

source.name: Fluoroscopy study of a competitive eater's stomach capacity
source.publisher: University of Pennsylvania (Marc Levine et al.), reported via American Journal of Roentgenology

notes: Penn radiologists used real-time X-ray (fluoroscopy) with barium-coated hot dogs to compare a control subject against a top-ten competitive eater. The control stopped after 7; researchers stopped the competitive eater at 36 in 10 minutes. The competitor's stomach distended into a food-filled sac with almost no peristalsis.
